verdict.rationale: Square's Payments API 'take payments' section lists ACH bank transfer, Afterpay/Clearpay (BNPL), and Cash App Pay (a wallet) alongside card payments, and the Web Payments SDK sits on the same integration path. Apple Pay and Google Pay never appear in the pack, and the alternative methods show up only as navigation link titles with no detail. missing for 10: explicit Apple Pay and Google Pay support, bank-redirect methods beyond ACH, documentation showing these methods share a single integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration
